name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: A Base UI Slider rendered inside a DirectionProvider with direction="rtl" so the headless component flips to RTL, while a plain div carries the native dir="rtl" attribute for the surrounding HTML/CSS.
stateManaged: none — the demo holds no React state; Slider.Root is uncontrolled via defaultValue={25} and DirectionProvider is used uncontrolled with a static direction="rtl" prop
nonTrivialInteractions: DirectionProvider propagates its rtl direction via context to descendant Base UI components, making the Slider honor RTL reading direction
The outer div sets the native dir="rtl" attribute separately, illustrating the docs caveat that DirectionProvider does not affect HTML and CSS — applications must set dir/CSS themselves
Slider thumb is focusable with aria-label="Volume" and focus-visible outline styling for keyboard users
